description: A fictional cartoon science-fiction toy goo-squirter gadget, a chunky toy-like game prop (not a real object, no working parts). A short wide off-white body shaped like a rounded bean lying on its side. At the front a very wide short mid grey round tube with a thick rolled bright green rim round its open end and a dark centre. Standing upright on top of the body, in a mid grey collar, a tall clear glass jar filled flat bright slime green, with a flat mid grey ribbed screw lid. Two riveted mid grey bands wrap the body, one in front of the jar and one behind it, each with a row of round rivets. Under the front of the body a round flat mid grey pump knob on a short horizontal grey rod pointing forward. Behind it, under the rear half of the body, a chunky dark purple handle raked backward, with a bright yellow curved finger lever inside a rounded mid grey loop in front of the handle. At the rear the body ends in a round off-white stepped cap with a mid grey ring and a bright yellow round button in its centre. A bright yellow crank handle is on the right flank of the body.
proportions: About 0.48 m long, 0.18 m wide and 0.38 m tall. (length : width : height = 2.67 : 1 : 2.11)
sides: the bright yellow crank handle is on the right flank only; the left flank has none; everything else is symmetric left to right.
